title: ReportSYSTEMX
description: A reportsystem for your minecraft server.
body:
🚨 Advanced Report System (1.21.x)

A powerful and lightweight report system for your SMP server.

✨ Features:
- 📩 /report <player> <reason>
- 🆔 Unique Report ID system
- ⏱ Cooldown system (anti-spam)
- 🤖 Discord Webhook integration
- 🔄 Live report updates (OPEN / TAKEN / CLOSED)
- ⚡ Fast and optimized performance
- ⚙️ Fully configurable (webhook + cooldown)

📌 Commands:
- /report <player> <reason> → Create a report
- /reports → View all reports
- /reportadmin take <id> → Take a report
- /reportadmin close <id> → Close a report

⚙️ Configuration:
- Change webhook URL
- Adjust cooldown time
- Easy to setup

💡 Perfect for:
- SMP Servers
- Survival Servers
- PvP Servers
- Moderation systems

📦 Version:
✔ Supports Minecraft 1.21.x (Paper / Spigot)

🔧 Setup:
1. Put plugin in /plugins
2. Start server
3. Edit config.yml
4. Add your Discord Webhook
5. Done!

🔥 Simple, clean and effective report system for your server.
